Human beings conquered the distance on earth by discovering wheels.
They endeavored further. Then on December 17, 1903, the Wright brothers
in America made the first experiment of flying in a plane. In the experiment, a
machine carried a man and rose above by its own power. The machine was
called the ‘Wright Flyers’. It flew naturally ina smooth speed, and finally landed
without damage. That was human being’s first real take-off. And now, they
have got a supersonic speed. Ina supersonic speed, something travels faster
than sound! So the skys the limit now!
Modern aircraft companies are making revolutions in aviation technology.
Boeing as well as Airbus is producing modern passenger airplanes. These
planes fly very fast. Boeing 787 flies 950 km/h. However, Airbus 350 is) y
